BinDay - a Windows disk cleaner
===============================

WHAT IT IS
  BinDay looks for things your PC does not need any more: build output,
  dependency folders, package caches, temporary files, old installers and
  duplicate files. It shows you every item with the size it takes up and a
  plain explanation of why it is safe to remove. Nothing is deleted until you
  tick it and confirm.

INSTALL
  1. Unzip this folder anywhere (Desktop is fine).
  2. Double click Install.bat.
  3. BinDay appears on your Desktop and in the Start Menu.

  No admin rights. Nothing is installed outside your user profile.

UNINSTALL
  Double click Uninstall.bat.

FIRST RUN
  The folder to scan is pre-filled with your user profile. Change it if you
  want to scan a project folder instead, then press Scan.

  - Tick the items you want gone (or press "Tick all Safe items").
  - Press "Move to Recycle Bin" (recoverable) or "Delete permanently".
  - Only items marked Safe can be deleted permanently. Everything else is
    refused on purpose.

ALSO WORKS FROM THE COMMAND LINE
  BinDay.exe "C:\path\to\folder"
  scans that folder as soon as the window opens.

REQUIREMENTS
  Windows 10 (1903 or newer) or Windows 11.
  .NET Framework 4.8 ships with those versions of Windows.

NOTES
  - Items moved to the Recycle Bin still use disk space until you empty it.
  - Cleanup history is written to %LOCALAPPDATA%\BinDay\history.jsonl.
  - Errors are written to %LOCALAPPDATA%\BinDay\error.log.
